title: Surgical protocol for pulmonary artery banding in mice to model right ventricular failure
author: Mamazhakypov, Veith, et al.
materials: WECK 523735 Hemoclip Traditional small titanium ligating clips,
ligating clip placed around the pulmonary trunk,

steps.title: Assemble mouse endotracheal tube
steps.instruction: Cut a 2.8 cm piece from a 20‑gauge intravenous catheter (Cat#10309) for the tube; cut a 3 cm blunted cannula from a 14‑gauge catheter (Cat#4268210S‑01); cut a 7 cm stylet from a 20‑gauge catheter; attach the tube to a 0.8 cm PE‑190 connector, then to a 1.5 cm PE‑240 extender; connect this assembly to the 3 cm blunted 14‑gauge cannula; insert the 7 cm 20‑gauge stylet through the cannula to serve as a stiff guide.

steps.title: Make vessel probe
steps.instruction: Bend the tip of a 26‑gauge blunted needle into an L‑shape and attach it to a 2 mL syringe to serve as a holder.

steps.title: Fabricate chest retractors
steps.instruction: Cut off the sharp tips of 20‑gauge needles, flatten them, then bend each twice as shown in Figure 2.2 to create the retractors.

steps.title: Customize clip applier
steps.instruction: Drill a hole in one handle of the Hemoclip applier (Cat#523140), insert a small bolt and secure it with a matching nut to create an adjustable stop that sets the clip width.

steps.title: Build mouse intubation stand
steps.instruction: Clamp a 50‑mL syringe (Cat#8728810F) horizontally to a lab stand, set the clamp height to ~10–12 cm from the base, and attach a blunted 18‑gauge needle to the syringe.

steps.title: Sterilize surgical instruments
steps.instruction: Place all surgical tools in a Germinator 500 Glass Bead Sterilizer (Cat#720127); after each use clean with Helizyme enzymatic detergent (Cat#18767) and a soft brush.

steps.title: Administer pre‑operative analgesia
steps.instruction: Inject buprenorphine hydrochloride (Temgesic) subcutaneously at 0.1 mg/kg 30 min before surgery; pause for 30 min before proceeding.

steps.title: Prepare mouse for surgery
steps.instruction: Shave the chest wall and apply Braunoderm adhesive (Cat#3881105) over the skin; illuminate the field with a power light and flexible horns throughout the procedure.

steps.title: Make transverse skin incision
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, cut a ~5 mm transverse incision 2 mm lateral to the left sternal border and 2 mm below the armpit level.

steps.title: Expose ribs with retractors
steps.instruction: Gently pull apart the thoracic muscles with retractors to reveal the ribs.

steps.title: Open thoracic cavity
steps.instruction: Make a small incision with scissors (Cat#14090‑11) at the second intercostal space, 2–3 mm from the left sternal border, to enter the cavity.

steps.title: Insert chest retractors
steps.instruction: Place 3–4 retractors sequentially into the incision, spreading the wound to a width of 4–5 mm, then secure them to the plate with surgical tape.

steps.title: Retract thymus and fat
steps.instruction: Move the thymus and surrounding adipose tissue out of the surgical field.

steps.title: Expose pericardium and pulmonary trunk
steps.instruction: Pull the pericardial sac apart with two forceps and attach it to the retractors' teeth; after mobilization, visualize the pulmonary trunk.

steps.title: Dissect pulmonary trunk
steps.instruction: Using curved Moria forceps (Cat#11370‑31), bluntly dissect connective and fatty tissue to separate the pulmonary trunk from the aorta and left atrium, taking care not to damage great vessels, left superior vena cava, left atrium, or left lung apex.

steps.title: Create tunnel under pulmonary trunk
steps.instruction: Insert the L‑shaped vessel probe (step 2) from the side of the trunk nearest the infundibulum and gently advance it beneath the trunk until its tip appears between the pulmonary artery and aorta.

steps.title: Place Hemoclip around pulmonary trunk
steps.instruction: Using a specially adapted clip applier set to a 0.3 mm width (≈65–70 % luminal occlusion), place a Hemoclip titanium ligating clip (Cat#523735) around the pulmonary trunk; inspect to confirm proper constriction.

steps.title: Remove retractors and reposition thymus
steps.instruction: Take out all chest retractors and return the thymus to its physiological location.

steps.title: Re‑inflate lungs
steps.instruction: Close the ventilator outflow tube for 1–2 s using fingers to re‑inflate the lungs.

steps.title: Close chest cavity
steps.instruction: Suture the second and third ribs together with a 6‑0 polypropylene suture (Cat#EH7228H), applying slight pressure on the chest with a needle holder (Cat#12060‑01) while tying the knot to minimize residual air.

steps.title: Restore muscle position
steps.instruction: Return all chest muscles to their physiological positions.

steps.title: Close skin
steps.instruction: Close the skin incision with 6‑0 polypropylene sutures.

steps.title: Apply wound dressing
steps.instruction: Treat the surgical wound with Braunoderm (Cat#3881105).

steps.title: Terminate anesthesia
steps.instruction: Turn off the isoflurane vaporizer.

steps.title: Post‑operative care – tape removal
steps.instruction: Remove adhesive tapes from the mouse’s paws.

steps.title: Check spontaneous breathing
steps.instruction: Stop the ventilator briefly and observe chest movements to confirm regular spontaneous breathing.

steps.title: Extubate mouse
steps.instruction: After confirming breathing, turn off the ventilator completely and remove the endotracheal tube.

steps.title: Recovery monitoring
steps.instruction: Place the mouse under a heating lamp and monitor closely for 4–6 h to ensure full recovery from anesthesia.

steps.title: Return to housing
steps.instruction: Put the mouse in a standard rodent cage with ad libitum food and water.

steps.title: Provide postoperative analgesia
steps.instruction: Administer buprenorphine hydrochloride (Temgesic) subcutaneously at 0.1 mg/kg twice daily for 3–5 days.
